paragraph: Twenty-seven people from a community center in Incheon, South Korea sat down to barbecue lunch. Some were staff. Some were disabled residents. A stranger paid the entire bill of $420 and left no name. The group never got to say thank you.

seed.summary: Members of a South Korean disabled community group were shocked to hear that a total stranger had paid for their barbecue lunch worth $420. The story begins when the party of 27 community center staff and disabled residents from the city of Incheon, just west of the capital Seoul, stopped for lunch at a BBQ
seed.sourceTitle: Stranger Anonymously Pays $420 Lunch Tab for 27 Disabled Residents and Caregivers
